snippet.title: Domain of Hallucination - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Domain of Hallucination is a roguelite game in pixel art style featuring meta-progression, in which content can be continuously unlocked over multiple playthroughs and the experience can be customized. During a playthrough, players can build their own game world and fight various bullet hell bosses. Within a hallucination, you fight your way through three areas from the memory of a magician with amnesia, revealing his past.

Available on Steam via Early Access now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363580/Domain_of_Hallucination/
